summary: Official ANCPI, OCPI Timiș, and Timișoara municipal pages establish cadastral custodians and a public parcel-layer candidate, but live bounded anonymous requests failed with DNS/gateway/timeout outcomes and no safe parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Romanian discovery queries are recorded in city-262-timi-oara.json. They identified the ANCPI Cadastral Parcel ArcGIS layer, OCPI Timiș cadastral-publication page, and Timișoara municipal cadastral/GIS pages.
requestOutcomes: The ANCPI layer metadata search result described polygon geometry and GeoJSON support, but direct curl failed DNS resolution, ANCPI inspection returned 502, the alternate geoportal.gov.ro inspection timed out, and OCPI Timiș map inspection returned HTTP 525. No credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, or formal submission was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [45.7497794549937, 21.2271321583919] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift was made.
The bounded query envelope was only a request attempt; its failure is not evidence of an exact-point miss or citywide parcel absence.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, live source schema, or CRS response was retained.
National ANCPI layer metadata and municipal custody evidence do not establish Timișoara-specific citywide open coverage.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research completion only; it does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
